title: Molecular Odor Prediction and Multidimensional Validation Study Based on a Two-Level Stacking Ensemble Model
description: A molecular odor dataset release accompanying a two-level stacking-ensemble study. The archive contains the supplied pure_holographic_971_dataset.csv file and README documentation. It is intended to support transparent data inspection, feature engineering, odor-prediction experiments, and multidimensional validation. Users should consult the data columns and source provenance in the documentation, preserve the original file, report preprocessing and train/test decisions, and treat predictive performance as dependent on the stated split and evaluation protocol.
